newsitem.title: UK: GKN climbs as SBC Warburg rates "buy".
newsitem.headline: GKN climbs as SBC Warburg rates "buy".

text.p: Shares in GKN Plc climbed on Thursday after analysts at SBC Warburg, the company's broker, restated a buy recommendation on the stock, dealers said.
GKN shares were up 26-1/2p at 966-1/2 by 1006 GMT on volume of 1.03 million.
"Warburgs rated it a buy and we've seen a bit of interest on the back of that," one dealer said.
Analysts at SBC Warburg were not immediately available for comment.
GKN shares weakened earlier this week after analysts at BZW on Monday cut their forecasts for engineering firms because of the strength of sterling and issued a "neutral" rating on the sector.
